Markets YEMEN

Markets YEMEN is a Yemeni platform for discovering, searching, and tracking product prices across cities and markets in Yemen. The platform organizes price information by product, category, and city, helping users understand current prices and monitor price changes over time.

Overview
Markets YEMEN provides structured information about prices of products and essential commodities in Yemen. Users can explore current prices, search for specific products, filter results by city and category, submit new price information, and review historical price changes.
The platform aims to make price information easier to find, compare, and understand across Yemeni markets.
Main Services

Browse current product prices in Yemen.
Search for products and commodities.
Filter prices by city and product category.
Explore prices of essential goods and food products.
Submit new price observations for review.
Review submitted prices before approval.
Track historical price changes.
Compare available price information across cities.

Prices

Product Prices: Browse product prices by city and category.
Main Website: Access the main Markets YEMEN website.

Cities and Markets
The platform organizes price information by city, allowing users to explore available prices in different parts of Yemen.
Cities of interest include:

Sana'a (صنعاء)
Taiz (تعز)
Aden (عدن)

Additional cities may be included as price information becomes available.
Products and Categories
Markets YEMEN organizes products into categories to make searching and browsing easier.
Examples of relevant products include:

Rice (الأرز)
Flour (الدقيق)
Sugar (السكر)
Cooking oil (زيت الطهي)
Wheat (القمح)
Beans and legumes (البقوليات)
Tea (الشاي)
Other essential food products and consumer goods

Product availability and displayed prices depend on the information recorded on the platform.
Price Verification
Prices submitted by users are not automatically treated as approved current prices.
The verification workflow is:

A user submits price information for a product.
The submission is reviewed.
The price may be approved after verification.
An approved price can update the current price record.
Price history can be retained to help track changes over time.

Unverified submissions should not be interpreted as confirmed market prices.
Data Structure
The platform manages information related to:

Products
Categories
Cities
Current Prices
Price Submissions
Price History
Users

These data structures support product discovery, price review, and historical tracking.

Language
Arabic is the primary language of the website. English terminology may also appear in technical documentation and structured data.
Country and Coverage

Country: Yemen
Primary market: Yemeni local markets
Geographic organization: City-based price information

Important Notes

Displayed prices depend on the data available on the platform.
Prices may vary by city, seller, product specification, quantity, and unit.
Not every product or city necessarily has current price information.
Submitted prices require review before they can be treated as approved records.
Historical prices represent recorded observations and should not automatically be interpreted as current prices.
